question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ADD
solution: The correct answer is "**Remove**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the word. • **ADD**: join (something) to something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount. • Let's look at the **meaning **of the given words. • **Remove**: taking something off. • **Continue**: persist in an activity or process. • **Multiply**: increase or cause to increase greatly in number or quantity. • **Increase**: become or make greater in size, amount, or degree. • As per the meaning of the given words, "**Remove**" is the antonym of "**add**". • **Example**: *The worshippers **removed**__** **their slippers before entering the shrine.* • Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • Let's look at the meaning of the word. • **ADD**: आकार, संख्या या राशि बढ़ाने के लिए किसी और चीज से जोड़ना (कुछ)। • Let's look at the meaning of the given words. • **Remove**: हटाना। • **Continue**: किसी गतिविधि या प्रक्रिया में बने रहना। • **Multiply**: संख्या या मात्रा में बहुत वृद्धि करना। • **Increase**: आकार, राशि या डिग्री में बड़ा होना या बनना। • As per the meaning of the given words, "**Remove**" is the antonym(विलोम) of "add". 3c:Tb1c, The correct answer is "**Fulcrum**"
